native_context: JavaScript application and bundle security analysis
taxonomy_note: Planning lens only; actual root-cause mapping is independent.

controls.boundary: JavaScript analysis: artifact → data flow → supported finding — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Preserve the shipped bundle hash, build/runtime, chunk relationship and source-map provenance. Open actual callsites and their consumers; keep public client identifiers apart from credentials.
controls.controlled_verification: For a recovered request builder, resolve method, base URL, dynamic identifiers and credential mode. Follow its argument back to a real source and forward to the server or browser sink. If the helper marks a value unresolved, inspect the binding/wrapper manually; do not replace it with a guessed URL. A route string becomes a finding only after a violated authority or execution boundary is evidenced.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Comments, regex text, dead code and a public source map are not execution. An AST method-name match has no guaranteed receiver binding. Embedded map content with unvalidated mappings is not proof of deployed source equivalence.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Repair the actual consumer boundary, preserving the feature. Rerun the relevant call path on the changed shipped build; minification or deleting a visible endpoint string is not a server authorization repair.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
